[[File:Elan Morin Tedronai.jpg|250px|thumb|right]]
'''Ishamael''' (ih-SHAH-may-EHL; /ɪˈʃɑ.mɛɪˌɛɫ/; [[Old Tongue]]: ''Betrayer of Hope''), originally named '''Elan Morin Tedronai''', was the most powerful of the [[Forsaken]] and their ''de facto'' leader during the [[War of Power]]. He was officially granted the title of [[Nae'blis]], giving him direct authority over all followers of the [[Dark One]]. Known for his dark eyes and cruel lips, Ishamael's mellifluous voice and profound strength in the [[One Power]] positioned him above all other channelers except [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Rahvin]]. His history traces back to the [[Age of Legends]], where he was a philosopher and theologian whose esoteric writings were influential yet lacked popular appeal. His conversion to the Shadow was fueled by a logical but flawed belief in the Dark One's inevitable victory due to the cyclical nature of the [[Wheel of Time]]. Throughout the ages, Ishamael repeatedly emerged from the Dark One's prison, taking on the name '''Ba'alzamon''' ("Heart of the Dark" in [[Trolloc]] tongue) and significantly impacting events such as the [[Trolloc Wars]] and [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s reign. Eventually, Ishamael was defeated by Rand al'Thor in the [[Heart of the Stone]] of [[Tear]], but was later resurrected by the Dark One as '''[[Moridin]]''' ([[Old Tongue]] for ''death'').
